rationale: Cross-sectional series of clinically diagnosed wound infections; no operated-patient denominator; AMR-focused descriptive analysis.

rationale: AMR-only convenience series of 58 SSI patients; no operated-patient denominator.

rationale: Retrospective chart review of 1248 records across two hospitals; no AST data.

rationale: Cross-sectional AMR study of 422 patients with suspected SSI; no operated-patient denominator.

rationale: Prospective surveillance cohort of 1022 surgical patients; SSI numerator derived from reported percentage.

rationale: AMR-only series of 109 SSI patients; no operated denominator; counts partly derived from table percentages.

rationale: Multicentre AMR-only series of 752 SSI patients; no operated denominator; MRSA denominator inconsistent.
